name: Eclipse Challenge (Hardcore Judgment Ring Mode)
author: Nocturne
description: High-stakes Judgment Ring challenge for SH1, SH2 & SH3: missed Rings inflict configurable Cash Tax and Party HP Drain, while Perfect Strikes earn clutch bonus rewards.

settings.label: Ring Miss Cash Tax
settings.description: Cash deducted every time a Judgment Ring attempt misses

settings.label: Ring Miss HP Drain %
settings.description: Percent of Max HP drained from living party members on a Ring miss (leaves at least 1 HP)

settings.label: Clutch Perfect Bounty
settings.description: Bonus Cash awarded on each Perfect Strike to reward mastery

settings.label: Show Eclipse Badge
settings.description: Display the ECLIPSE challenge counter in the corner HUD
